intro.title: Gemstone Yantras
intro.descriptionHtml: Exclusive collection of Yantras on Gemstones which provide dual benefits that of the Yantra geometry and that of the gemstone. Yantras on Gemstones are made with various Gemstones with UV prints of the Yantra of a particular Deity and are mounted on lovely stands. The Gemstones used are connected to the Deity of Yantra. Worshipping and meditating on these Yantras, by focusing on the Yantra blesses devotees and fulfill desires.
